name: Lagoon Nebula
summary: A cloud of glowing gas in Sagittarius where young stars are forming.

name: Hercules Cluster
summary: A dense, roughly spherical group of old stars in the constellation Hercules.

name: Andromeda Galaxy
summary: A large spiral galaxy and one of the Milky Way’s closest galactic neighbours.

name: Triangulum Galaxy
summary: A spiral galaxy in the Local Group, named for the constellation Triangulum.

name: Orion Nebula
summary: A nearby stellar nursery that appears in the sword of Orion.

name: Whirlpool Galaxy
summary: A spiral galaxy interacting with its smaller neighbour, NGC 5195.
